long_biography.plain_text:
The Legend Group was the financial-services platform Philip C. Restino owned and directed. Its advisers served school districts and other not-for-profit organisations, combining mutual-fund distribution with long-term retirement planning. Restino owned the parent company outright and held majority positions in several affiliated businesses.

He also served for years as president and director of Legend Advisory Corporation while maintaining registrations through Legend Capital and Legend Investment Management. That network joined advisory, brokerage and administrative work around retirement programmes. Palm Beach Liquidators remains an active Florida corporation with Restino as president and director.
